faqs.question: Does “Pressurising fuel” add a cell to Diesel 120 concrete pump?
faqs.answer: No. Diesel 120 Concrete Pump is a high-capacity diesel trailer concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, Hebei, China.

faqs.question: Can “Metering fuel” fill a blank cell for Diesel 120 concrete pump?
faqs.answer: No. Blank cells for Diesel 120 concrete pump stay blank.
